title: Hallucination as Creativity: Harnessing Novelty and Safeguarding Reliability in AI-Generated Ideas

contributions.purpose: 提出量化新颖性与可信度权衡的指标
contributions.mechanism: Creative Utility Score(CUS),嵌入发散度 N(c) 与验证校准可信度 P(c) 加权(权重 α)
contributions.evaluation: 消融显示性能在 α≈0.6 附近峰值;去掉不确定性 U(c) 使 Correctness@20 降 0.08
contributions.domain: LLM 科学创意生成/幻觉控制
contributions.source_quote: We introduce the Creative Utility Score (CUS), a metric to quantify and regulate the trade-off between novelty and plausibility.

contributions.purpose: 设计自适应调节幻觉强度的 agent 架构
contributions.mechanism: 三模式(Exploratory/Grounding/Adaptive),Adaptive 用 α←f(U(c)) 由集成方差+验证器置信度调,检索深度与弃权阈值由 bandit 协调
contributions.source_quote: We design an adaptive agent architecture that dynamically modulates hallucination intensity across exploratory, grounding, and adaptive modes.

contributions.purpose: 实证受控幻觉可增创意而不失可靠
contributions.mechanism: 数学(CAS/SAT 验证)+生医(PubMed 检索+专家 Likert)双域评测,对比 Greedy-RAG 等基线
contributions.source_quote: We empirically validate our approach in mathematics and biomedicine, showing that adaptive regulation produces hypotheses that are simultaneously novel, useful, and reliable.

notes: trade-off:Exploratory 新颖性最高但"significant plausibility decay",强验证器换 +0.05 AUROC 代价 -3% novelty。数据红旗:全部结果仅以正文散句给出(5.8 Results),无任何结果表/CI/误差棒;数字异常干净且整。checklist 过度自证:Q6-8 声称报告了 data splits、GPU、内存、运行时、置信区间与 inter-rater,但正文 5.9 把硬件与 wall-clock 全推给"supplementary",正文未见对应表——披露与内容不一致(疑占位/夸大)。checklist AI 自披露:每条 justification 均"ChatGPT generated/documented/reported...",即 ChatGPT 代写。github 链接非匿名(myai007),破坏双盲隐患。
